claims: High Point University is a private liberal arts institution in North Carolina.
High Point University is known as "The Premier Life Skills University".
The Princeton Review consistently ranks High Point University as the #1 Best-Run College.
High Point University has a 99% job/graduate school placement rate.
High Point University offers 73 undergraduate majors.
High Point University has the Phillips School of Business.
High Point University has the Congdon School of Health Sciences.
High Point University has the Workman School of Dental Medicine.
High Point University is a Methodist-affiliated institution.
High Point University has a roughly 77% acceptance rate.
Total estimated costs for tuition, fees, and room/board at High Point University for 2026-2027 are approximately $71,429.
High Point University competes in NCAA Division I athletics.
High Point University is part of the Big South Conference.
High Point University features 17 varsity sports.
